Docs.summary: CcfReceiptVerifier contains the methods to verify a CCF SCITT receipt's integrity and its inclusion in the Signing Transparency Service. Verification requires the receipt, the COSE_Sign1 signed statement that was submitted to the service, and the service's public receipt-verification key. The receipt can also be embedded in the COSE_Sign1 envelope.
